abstract: For every prime $p \ge 7$ and every reduced non-polynomial rational function $f(X)=P(X)/Q(X)\in\mathbb{F}_p(X)$ ($\gcd(P,Q)=1$, $\deg Q\ge 1$) of projective plane degree $N(f):=\max(\deg P,\deg Q+1)\le 6$, we establish unconditional sub-$1.80n+O(mp^{1/2})$ upper bounds for all queen-admissible and Euclidean no-three-in-line subsets $S\subseteq\Gamma_p(f)\cap W_m(x_0,y_0)$ in **every** translated whole-period square window $W_m(x_0,y_0)=[x_0,x_0+mp)\times[y_0,y_0+mp)\cap\mathbb{Z}^2$ ($n=mp$, $m\ge 1$), and sub-$1.80n+O((n/p)p^{1/2})$ bounds in every translated square window of side $n\ge k_0(N)p$. Once $N(f)\ge 3$, $\Gamma_p(f)$ violates the class-q hypothesis ($\Theta(p^2)$ generic residue lines meet $\Gamma_p(f)$ in $3$ to $6$ points) and escapes polynomial Abhyankar--Moh barriers ($\infty$ is not totally ramified): on degree-$4$ $V_4$ Lattès quartics with leading scalar $c\notin\{0,\pm 1\}$, all four queen directions individually exceed $1.80n$ ($2.00n$ horizontally/vertically, $\frac{11}{6}n$ diagonally) while the unique cancelling slope $s=c$ has primitive grid height $u+|v|\ge 3$ so its single-direction Euclidean bound on $W_m$ exceeds $2.27n$ for $m\ge 3$; meanwhile at $N(f)=5$ ($p\equiv 1\pmod 4$), conjugate Vélu $5$-isogeny Lattès maps $\psi_{\pm i}$ on $E_{\pm i}/\{\pm 1\}$ ($j=1728$) produce a family $f_K(X)$ where **both** $f_K(X)$ and $f_K(X)-X$ are exact $D_5$-bijections on $\mathbb{F}_p$. We overcome both obstructions via (1) a hybrid bound uniting single-direction clipped capacities with reversal-symmetric two-diagonal coarse-fiber potentials across all $m\ge 2$ and all $29$ transitive monodromy groups in degrees $2\le d\le 6$, and (2) an exhaustive algebraic monodromy classification across all Hurwitz-admissible pole portraits for $N(f)\le 6$—proved via direct symbolic Wronskian divisibility and explicit integral Bézout identities over $\mathbb{Z}$—establishing that $f_K(X)$ is the **unique** double-exceptional configuration and that its opposite diagonal $f_K(X)+X$ has monodromy $S_5$ ($p\ne 157$, rate $\frac{107}{60}n$) or Frobenius coset $S_5\setminus A_5$ ($p=157$, rate $\frac{5}{3}n$). Uniformly across all $m\ge 2$, $|S|\le\frac{43}{24}n+O(mp^{1/2})$ for $N(f)\le 5$ and $|S|\le\frac{431}{240}n+O(mp^{1/2})$ for $N(f)=6$. The unrestricted $1.8n$ problem remains open.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: 1. Resolved Critique 1 (Finite-characteristic elimination): Replaced all Z[b]-GCD and square-discriminant resultant inferences with direct symbolic proofs and explicit integral Bezout identities over Z. Specifically: (a) proved Lemma 4.1 directly from the Wronskian identity P^3 + b_2 P^2 Q_4 + b_1 P Q_4^2 + b_0 Q_4^3 = L_3 W_6^2 with zero resultants, establishing the universal linear invariant 3r_0 + r_1 = 1 across both Type II Dickson and Type III Velu (1,2,2)-pole D_5 covers (eliminating Row 4A-iii and unifying Row 3B-i across all p >= 7, and explaining why the p=13, b=8, c=9 example has an A_5 triple-root fiber (1,1,3)); (b) proved explicit integral Bezout identities U(b, x_0)m_2 + V(b, x_0)m_3 = -b^7(b^2 + 1)^2 in Z[b, x_0] (Lemma 4.3, Section 4.4), (27 - 36z_0^2)m_1^II + 5(12z_0^4 + 51z_0^2 - 77)m_3^II = 250 = 2*5^3 in Z[z_0] (Type II Pole Case (ii)), and sum Phi_ij K_ij = 27(v^2 - 4)^4 in Z[s, v] (Row 3B-ii). 2. Resolved Critique 2 (Differential congruence and normalization): Stated and proved Lemma 4.2 completely symbolically in the 9-variable polynomial ring Z[X, Q_4, P, Q_4', P', M, c_5, beta_3, tilde_beta_3] (zero integer specializations), first proving R_{tilde_f} = R_f mod Q_4 from tilde_P = P mod Q_4 and then deriving (4X + beta_3 - tilde_beta_3)P = (2c_5 - 1)(Q_4')^2 mod Q_4; stated and proved Lemma 4.3 specifying the exact reciprocal-inversion domain/codomain Mobius maps z = x_0 + 1/X, quartic M(z) = (N_b(z)D_b(x_0) - N_b(x_0)D_b(z))/(z - x_0), Q_4(X) = M(x_0)^-1 X^4 M(x_0 + 1/X), and Neron-differential reduction to (D_b(z), D_y(z), z D_y(z)) mod M(z). 3. Resolved Critique 3 (Lattes quartic slopes & Gaussian-CM monodromy): Corrected Section 1.1 and Abstract to treat the degree-3 S_3 cancellation at s = c and the physical window geometry u + |v| >= 3 on W_m when c notin {0, +-1}; removed the erroneous [2+i]-[i] remark and proved G^geom(f_K) = G^geom(f_K - X) = D_5 directly in Theorem 4 via explicit symbolic Mobius conjugacy over Z[1/5, 1/2, i, alpha]/(alpha^2 - 1 + 2i) to the conjugate Velu 5-isogeny Lattes maps psi_{+i} and psi_{-i}. 4. Credit & self-containedness: Added Section 1.3 and References [17] (Ferraguti-Micheli), [18] (Ding-Zieve), and [19] (Bisson-Tibouchi), plus self-contained derivations of the V_4 orbit-sum normal form (4.1) and the degree-5 C_5/D_5 genus-0 cover classification.
title: Sub-1.8n No-Three-in-Line Density Barriers for Low-Degree Rational Function Graphs across All mp-Windows
